title: Legal notice and privacy
description: Publisher, host, personal data and visitor rights for paulperigault.fr.

sections.title: Site publisher
paragraphs: The site {domain} is published by Paul Perigault, in a personal and professional capacity.
Publication director: Paul Perigault.
Contact: {email}.

sections.title: Hosting and domains
paragraphs: The site is a static site hosted by GitHub Pages: GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States.
The main domain is {domain}; the address paulperigault.dev redirects to it.
The service that receives contact form messages is hosted by Cloudflare, Inc. (101 Townsend Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, United States) at contact.paulperigault.dev.

sections.title: Personal data
paragraphs: This site sets no cookie and uses no audience measurement or advertising tool. When pages open, it loads no third-party resource (fonts, scripts, images, videos). Only the contact form relies on third-party services, and only when you use it (see "Contact form").

Like any web host, GitHub may record technical connection data (IP address, date and time, requested pages) to keep the service secure and running. This processing is GitHub's responsibility and is described in its privacy statement, including transfers of data outside the European Union.

sections.title: Contact form
paragraphs: The form in the Contact section sends your name, your email address and your message. They are only used to reply to you (legal basis: legitimate interest in answering requests). The form only exists with JavaScript; you can also write directly to {email}.

The message goes through a Cloudflare Workers service that checks it and hands it to the Resend email delivery service (Resend, Inc., sending from the European Union region, in Ireland). This service neither stores nor logs your message. It then reaches my inbox ({email}), where it is kept for the duration of the exchange.

To block automated submissions, the form uses Cloudflare Turnstile. This service only loads when you start filling in the form, never when the page opens. It analyses technical information about your browser and connection, including the IP address, to tell a person from a bot; Cloudflare processes it under its own privacy policy. Measured on this site: no cookie is set; Cloudflare stores a technical value ("cf.turnstile.u") in the storage of its own embedded frame, separate from this site's storage.
Cloudflare, Inc. and Resend, Inc. are companies based in the United States.

sections.title: Browser local storage
paragraphs: Two display preferences are saved in your browser's local storage when you change them: “theme” (light or dark) and “lang” (French or English). They stay on your device, are never sent to a server and only personalise the display at your request; they therefore do not require consent. You can delete them at any time from your browser settings.
The site itself writes nothing else. If you use the contact form, Cloudflare Turnstile stores a technical value in the storage of its own frame (see "Contact form").

sections.title: External links
paragraphs: The site links to GitHub and LinkedIn. These services apply their own privacy rules as soon as you click a link; they receive no data from this site until you do. The PDF resume is served by this site itself.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: If you write to {email} or through the contact form, your name, address and message are only used to reply to you and kept as long as this exchange requires (legal basis: legitimate interest in answering requests).

Under the GDPR you have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability regarding data about you, which you can exercise at the same address. If you disagree, you may lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The texts and visuals of this site belong to Paul Perigault unless stated otherwise. The site's source code is public on GitHub.
